name: cyboflow
description: Cyboflow - Multi-session AI code assistant manager

scripts.electron-dev: node scripts/ensure-sqlite-abi.mjs electron && concurrently "pnpm run --filter frontend dev" "node scripts/dev-electron.mjs --cdp"
scripts.electron-dev:custom: node scripts/ensure-sqlite-abi.mjs electron && concurrently "pnpm run --filter frontend dev" "node scripts/dev-electron.mjs"
scripts.dev:perf: node scripts/ensure-sqlite-abi.mjs electron && concurrently "pnpm run --filter frontend dev" "node scripts/dev-electron.mjs --cdp --inspect --perf"
scripts.build: pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm run build:main && pnpm run build:electron
scripts.build:main: pnpm run --filter main build && node scripts/bundle-mcp-server.mjs && node scripts/bundle-preload.mjs
scripts.build:mac: pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm run build:main && pnpm run electron:rebuild && pnpm run inject-build-info && node scripts/configure-build.js && electron-builder --mac --universal --publish never --config build/electron-builder.generated.json
scripts.build:mac:universal: pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm run build:main && pnpm run electron:rebuild && pnpm run inject-build-info && node scripts/configure-build.js && electron-builder --mac --universal --publish never --config build/electron-builder.generated.json
scripts.build:mac:x64: pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm run build:main && pnpm run electron:rebuild && pnpm run inject-build-info && BUILD_ARCH=x64 node scripts/configure-build.js && electron-builder --mac --x64 --publish never --config build/electron-builder.generated.json
scripts.build:mac:arm64: pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm run build:main && pnpm run electron:rebuild && pnpm run inject-build-info && BUILD_ARCH=arm64 node scripts/configure-build.js && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never --config build/electron-builder.generated.json
scripts.build:mac:ci: pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm run build:main && pnpm run electron:rebuild && pnpm run inject-build-info && node scripts/configure-build.js && electron-builder --mac --universal --publish never --config build/electron-builder.generated.json
scripts.release:mac: CYBOFLOW_BUILD_ENV=stable pnpm run build:mac && pnpm run publish:r2
scripts.release:mac:universal: CYBOFLOW_BUILD_ENV=stable pnpm run build:mac:universal && pnpm run publish:r2
scripts.build:mac:dev: pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm run build:main && pnpm run electron:rebuild && BUILD_VARIANT=dev pnpm run inject-build-info && BUILD_VARIANT=dev node scripts/configure-build.js && electron-builder --mac --universal --publish never --config build/electron-builder.generated.json
scripts.build:mac:dev:arm64: pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm run build:main && pnpm run electron:rebuild && BUILD_VARIANT=dev pnpm run inject-build-info && BUILD_VARIANT=dev BUILD_ARCH=arm64 node scripts/configure-build.js && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never --config build/electron-builder.generated.json
scripts.build:mac:dev:x64: pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm run build:main && pnpm run electron:rebuild && BUILD_VARIANT=dev pnpm run inject-build-info && BUILD_VARIANT=dev BUILD_ARCH=x64 node scripts/configure-build.js && electron-builder --mac --x64 --publish never --config build/electron-builder.generated.json
scripts.release:mac:dev: CYBOFLOW_BUILD_ENV=dev pnpm run build:mac:dev && BUILD_VARIANT=dev pnpm run publish:r2
scripts.build:win: node scripts/ensure-sqlite-abi.mjs electron && pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm run build:main && pnpm run inject-build-info && node scripts/configure-build.js --platform win --arch x64 && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never --config build/electron-builder.generated.json
scripts.build:win:dev: node scripts/ensure-sqlite-abi.mjs electron && pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm run build:main && pnpm run inject-build-info && node scripts/configure-build.js --platform win --arch x64 --variant dev && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never --config build/electron-builder.generated.json
scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm run electron:rebuild && pnpm run build:main
scripts.test:e2e: sh -c 'while [ "$1" = "--" ]; do shift; done; playwright test "$@"' --
scripts.e2e:prereqs: pnpm run build:main && pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm run electron:rebuild
scripts.test:build: node build/afterSign.test.js && node build/verifyArtifact.test.js && node scripts/configure-build.test.js
scripts.test:unit: node scripts/ensure-sqlite-abi.mjs host && pnpm --filter main test && pnpm --filter frontend test && pnpm run verify:schema && node scripts/__tests__/verify-schema-parity.test.js && node scripts/__tests__/release-scripts.test.js && node scripts/__tests__/ensure-sqlite-abi.test.js && node scripts/__tests__/apply-pty-napi-prebuilds.test.js && pnpm run test:build
scripts.test:gate: node scripts/ensure-sqlite-abi.mjs host && vitest run --config vitest.config.gate.ts
scripts.test:integration: node scripts/ensure-sqlite-abi.mjs host && vitest run --config vitest.config.integration.ts
